canonical_project: Nouakchott Data Hub (Centre d'hebergement de donnees numeriques de Nouakchott)
owner: SDIN (Societe pour le Developpement des Infrastructures Numeriques), owner/infrastructure role; operated by IMT (International Mauritania Telecom)
notes: National datacenter inaugurated 8 May 2025 in Tevragh-Zeina area (Nouakchott-Ouest / West Nouakchott; trustmag confirms locality). AMI confirms 1,372 m2, 100 server racks expandable, national hosting/cloud/secure backup/business continuity/AI-big-data services; EIB confirms EUR 15m loan, WARCIP context and IMT management; Uptime lists Tier III Certification of Design Documents + Tier III Certification of Constructed Facility (client SDIN). WARDIP Government Cloud (contract 1320/F/011/CPMP/MTNIMA/WARDIP/2025, HMN SMART, 2025-06-24) is a platform procurement hosted from this facility context - not a separate physical site. No public MW published; capacity_mw null per methodology.
